title: Stage-release-aware service composition
prior_art_boundary: Service-curve composition and min-plus Network Calculus are established prior art; this experiment tests a bounded semantic-materialization adaptation and does not claim a new Network Calculus theorem.
hypothesis: For a sequential materialization pipeline, downstream CPU service delivered before upstream transfer completion is not bankable; admission must count downstream service only after the stage release point.
falsifiers: exhaustive stage-aware operator disagrees with direct sequential simulation
independent absolute service checks never false-admit
front-loaded downstream service before release remains usable
stale upstream stage does not force replan
stage-aware Monte Carlo operator produces a false admit
